headword: {職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}

definitions.gloss: artisan temperament; craftsman spirit; dedication to one's craft
definitions.explanation: The disposition or work ethic typical of a skilled craftsperson: meticulous attention to detail, pride in quality, stubbornness about standards, and devotion to mastering one's trade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧だ。
examples.english: He's a cook with true craftsman spirit.

examples.japanese: {職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{妥協|だきょう}→妥協：07423_dakyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: With an artisan temperament, he doesn't allow any compromise.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エンジニア→エンジニア：05059_enjinia⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわり→こだわり：08346_kodawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That company has many engineers with a craftsman mentality, and they're particular about product quality.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧ (craftsperson) + {気質|かたぎ} (temperament/disposition). Note that {気質|かたぎ} uses the special reading かたぎ (not きしつ) when used as a suffix meaning "temperament typical of a group."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with craftsman spirit
- {職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧: stubbornly dedicated to craft
- {職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: having a strong artisan temperament

CULTURAL NOTE:
This concept is deeply valued in Japanese culture, reflecting respect for masters who devote their lives to perfecting a single craft. It applies beyond traditional trades — modern programmers, chefs, and designers are praised for having {職人気質|しょくにんかたぎ}.
